**Review — `scripts/doc_consistency.py` link checker (`check_links`, lines 103–121)**

Behavior traced against the test contract:

- Regex `\]\(([^)\s#]+)(?:#[^)\s]*)?\)` captures the path portion and drops any trailing `#fragment`. So `[ok](exists.md#section)` → `exists.md` (covered by `fragment`), and pure `[local](#section)` yields no match because the capture group requires at least one non-`#` char before `#` — correctly ignored, not flagged.
- Schemes `http://`, `https://`, `mailto:` are skipped by prefix check (covers `external`).
- Percent-decoding via `urllib.parse.unquote` before resolution makes `space%20name.md` resolve to the real `space name.md` (covers `encoded`).
- Resolution is `normpath(join(dirname(doc), target))`, so `../exists.md` from `docs/sub/index.md` resolves correctly (covers `nested`), and unicode filenames work since paths are only decoded, not re-encoded (covers `unicode`).
- A missing target appends `"{relative}: broken link -> {target}"` (raw, undecoded target), matching the expected strings for `missing`/`mixed`.
- A non-existent live document appends `"live document missing: {relative}"` before reading (covers `missing_document`).
